I can't fill in these values from the type declarations. They only type the keyboard options (`keys`, `preventDefault`, `angularSensitivity`, `panningSensitivity`, `zoomingSensitivity`) and declare `enableArcRotateKeyboardControls()` with no body. Nothing there says how simultaneous keys combine, whether movement is per-frame or time-scaled, or what Alt and Ctrl do. I also have no file tools in this session, so I couldn't write the file to disk. The null placeholders below are not measurements.

FILE: app/notes/arrow-keys.json
```json
{ "rotateFraction": null, "altFraction": null, "ctrlSameDistance": null }
```

To get real values, run the scene with the library installed, hold each key combination for 60 frames, and log `alpha` and `target` before and after each run. Then compute the ratios and compare the Ctrl target displacements. I'm not sure whether Lite's keyboard handler is per-frame or time-scaled, so the measured numbers depend on the frame timing of your run.
